piece.headline: Haaland blanks, Ayodele pounces: 2 points split the top
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked for 23 captain pickers. Cherag still leads the league, but Ayodele is breathing down his neck.
piece.big_picture: Haaland let down 23 of 29 captain pickers. Cherag survives, but a 9-point lead is now 2. Ayodele is the one closing in. Sid is third and has work to do.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Nanik left 28 points on the bench, the biggest waste in the league. Gold spots slipped away with them. Ayodele and Will binned 26 apiece.
piece.one_to_watch: The title race. Cherag leads Ayodele by just 2 points. If Ayodele's bench stops hoarding points, he could take top spot next week.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: Top score of the week and a climb into the top 4. N.Jackson came in and delivered. Skill, with a bit of nerve.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: Brought in Tavernier and N.Jackson, and jumped 6 places. A smart double swap. Skill, not luck.

winners.name: Raushan
winners.verdict: The only manager to captain N.Jackson. It returned 18 with the armband. That is nerve, and it paid off.

losers.name: Dinesh
losers.verdict: Left 19 points on the bench, and the XI he picked paid for it. That is a selection problem rather than bad luck.
